description: Calculate the weighted average entry price from multiple buy/sell fills (DCA): the bare number only, no breakeven or per-fill breakdown. Use when user asks only "what's my average entry?" and wants just that figure. For breakeven and a per-level summary too, use workflow.run_dca_entry instead. Returns: averagePrice, totalSize, totalCost.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined, average is the arithmetic mean (default). inverse = coin-margined, average is the harmonic mean (fill quantity is USD notional).

name: primitive.average_entry
